incidents.note: Both F1629 PBS failures stem from one R12 driver API regression and are counted as one incident with four specific code defects. Independently verified on GitHub (commit fa2a5100142c79fd03b7f2882d04da6d280d4076) under HND-bf29e0495841 and confirmed through full 140-outer-iteration Abaqus production execution (280 subproblem runs per job, Exit_status=0) in 1420429.mmaster02 and 1420430.mmaster02.

code_defects.detail: PDASReEquilibrationSolver instantiated at line 778 with unexpected keyword arguments penalty_active=1e9, penalty_free=0.0 instead of canonical (self.mesh, self.d0, self.h0, gc=GC_DEFAULT, l0=L0_DEFAULT, c_penalty=1.0, max_iter=30, tol_d=1e-5, tol_res=1e-4).

code_defects.summary: Incorrect staggered solver ordering and method/attribute calls
code_defects.detail: Assigned solver.h = history instead of solver.h_gp = history and invoked nonexistent solver.solve(...) with Phase before Mechanical instead of canonical Mechanical Abaqus solve -> displacement relaxation -> driving history update (solver.h_gp = history) -> solver.kkt(damage) -> Hintermueller-Ito-Kunisch active-set update -> Phase Abaqus solve.

Invoked nonexistent self.accelerator.step(...) instead of self.accelerator.compute_step(d_current=damage, d_pdas=new_damage_pdas, d0=self.d0, damped_omega=applied_omega_d, active_set_changed=False) gated by delta_active_sym <= self.anderson_max_active_diff.
Computed intrinsic raw displacement residual delta_u_raw against previous_u_abaqus instead of previous_u_trial.

incidents.note: In build_f1629_packages.py, Step 4 generated PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json before Step 5 generated *_AUTHORIZATION.json, causing PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json to record the prior revision's *_AUTHORIZATION.json SHA-256 and byte count while *_AUTHORIZATION.json circularly hashed PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json. Repaired in commit cb9af24ba91bcd66cf69d5104243d9318e62fd07 by generating *_AUTHORIZATION.json first (excluding PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json from auth['files']) and generating PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json second so PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json records the exact committed *_AUTHORIZATION.json SHA-256 and byte count, enforced by test_07_package_manifests_integrity and independently verified under HND-5b361e69abda.

In scripts/validation/evaluate_f1629_paired_execution.py, consistency gates evaluated missing evidence using 'is not False', allowing None values on nonconverged runs to evaluate to True. Repaired to fail closed strictly (requiring explicit True for mechanical consistency, history monotonicity, and thermodynamic consistency, and requiring non-null finite KKT residual components). Verified via 7 unit tests in tests/unit/test_f1629_evaluation_engine.py.

blocked_conditions.summary: Both F1630 production jobs completed all 140 outer iterations (280 Abaqus subproblem solves each) with Exit_status=0 (walltimes 01:20:20 and 01:21:28) and status=NONCONVERGED (converged checkpoint properly suppressed). Arm B applied 0 Anderson steps (94 Stage-1 gated iterations, 20 Stage-2 active-set resets with |Delta A|>5, 6 insufficient_history, and 19 Stage-2 candidates rejected by binary oversized_step > 0.045), rendering Arm A and Arm B bitwise identical across all 140 iterations (demonstrated_anderson_effect=False). Forensic analysis in F1631 conclusively confirmed that nonconvergence is driven by physical post-transfer crack propagation under sustained displacement boundary conditions (u_y = 0.0018703 mm), where mesh refinement sharpens the notch tip driving force (peak H = 28.55 MPa >> H_init = 0.18 MPa). Proposed successor is load-incremental forward continuation.

Compute-node direct outbound Telegram API delivery remains classified as UNRESOLVED in technical preflight, whereas login-node submission Telegram delivery and PBS sendmail (-m abe) delivery are verified PASS.
